name: How much value does an open floor plan add?

mainEntity.name: How much resale value can an open-floor-plan conversion add to a Los Angeles home?
mainEntity.text: How much resale value can an open-floor-plan conversion add to a Los Angeles home?

acceptedAnswer.text: An open-floor-plan conversion can improve marketability when it makes the home brighter, more usable, and easier to furnish. The value lift depends on whether the change aligns with buyer expectations in that specific neighborhood and price tier. A high-end home may benefit from a dramatic open main level, while a smaller family home may gain more from selective openness plus preserved storage. The best return usually comes from a conversion that looks intentional, not rushed, and that includes matching finishes, good lighting, and seamless transition details. Homeowners should evaluate the project as both a lifestyle upgrade and a resale feature rather than assuming openness alone guarantees a premium.
acceptedAnswer.description: Value depends on the neighborhood, the quality of the design, and whether the conversion improves function without sacrificing storage or privacy. A well-executed layout can help resale, but the return is not fixed.
